description: This file contains unit tests for the MessageAggregator class, which is an Akka actor responsible for aggregating messages and handling timeouts. The tests validate message aggregation, termination behavior, handling of irrelevant messages, and timeout reporting.

classes.name: MessageAggregatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the MessageAggregator actor in various scenarios.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem before each test.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: stopSelfIfExpectNoMessage
methods.description: Tests that the MessageAggregator stops itself when no messages are received within the expected period.

methods.name: aggregateMessagesAndStopSelf
methods.description: Tests message aggregation and ensures the actor terminates after receiving the expected number of messages.

methods.name: ignoreIrrelevantMessages
methods.description: Ensures that messages irrelevant to the aggregation are ignored and do not affect the aggregation process.

methods.name: reportPartialMessagesOnTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that the actor reports partial message aggregation results upon timeout.
